channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Ghosts in the machine
item.description: A car I was test-driving once came to a stop without me pressing the brake pedal. Traffic was barely moving, and a woman was walking between cars, crossing from one opening to the next. As she appeared to head toward the side of my vehicle, the collision-avoidance system suddenly applied the brakes.
